title: 🚀 Pairly beta launch at Westbrook University
text:
Public beta launch of Pairly at Westbrook University.

Launch day plan:
- 8 AM: Wop sends the launch email to all beta testers
- 8 AM: Tomas Rivera posts in the Westbrook campus group chat
- Daniel Ortiz watches the matching service and API response times all day
- Sam Okafor watches crash reports on Android and iOS
- Maya Chen posts the launch announcement

Checklist: "Beta launch checklist - Nov 2" page in Pairly HQ (Notion).
